title: Audio Ops — Stream Monitor
description: Live RTSP stream status and continuous inference results

targets.query:
from(bucket: "audio_metrics")
  |> range(start: -1m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "stream_health")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "active" or r._field == "frames_processed" or r._field == "error_count" or r._field == "rms" or r._field == "ingest_queue_depth")
  |> last()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["stream_id"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> keep(columns: ["stream_id", "url", "active", "frames_processed", "error_count", "rms", "ingest_queue_depth"])
  |> yield(name: "stream_status")

panels.title: RMS Signal Level — All Streams
panels.description: Audio energy per stream — spikes indicate speech/events

targets.query:
from(bucket: "audio_metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement =~ /^(stream_|inference_)/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "rms")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: r.stream_id }))
  |> yield(name: "rms")

from(bucket: "audio_metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement =~ /^stream_/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "confidence")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: r.stream_id + "/" + r.task }))
  |> yield(name: "confidence")

from(bucket: "audio_metrics")
  |> range(start: -5m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "stream_health")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "error_count" or r._field == "frames_processed")
  |> last()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["stream_id"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: if r.frames_processed > 0 then float(v: r.error_count) / float(v: r.frames_processed) * 100.0 else 0.0 }))
  |> mean()
  |> yield(name: "error_rate")
